nodes.title: ADR 0046: Own production release deployment in Orbit
ADR 0045: Isolate production PHP-FPM by Unix user
ADR 0034: Select AppInstance PHP from Composer constraints
ADR 0044: Own AppInstance environment configuration in Orbit

description:
Orbit prepares and activates production releases using the instance’s configured branch and application steps, and reports whether a failure occurred before or after the code switch.

## Scope

* In: synchronous Gateway deployment and code-rollback actions, per-invocation output events, remote execution bounds, and operation exclusion.
* Out: HTTP streaming transport, automatic retries, deployment history, application recovery, data rollback, inferred commands, and automatic release deletion.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Each explicit deploy fetches the latest configured branch into a fresh release and keeps that checkout for the whole invocation, including when the remote branch advances; no commit selector is accepted and a failed fetch leaves the selected release unchanged. Proof: Incus action `deployment-branch-source`.
- [ ] A deploy captures the current step configuration in memory, synchronizes stored environment values, then executes the configured pre-activation commands in order from the new release as the instance Unix user through a fixed non-interactive shell; commands are streamed as protected script content rather than interpolated infrastructure arguments. Proof: Incus action `deployment-step-context`.
- [ ] An empty list runs no application commands; neither cloning nor provisioning triggers deploy, and a command such as `php artisan migrate --force` runs only when explicitly configured. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Domain/DeployAppInstanceTest.php`.
- [ ] After all pre-activation commands succeed, one atomic `current` replacement selects the release, PHP cache refresh completes for its owning service, and post-activation commands run in order; non-PHP targets skip PHP refresh. Proof: Incus action `deployment-activation-order`.
- [ ] A pre-switch failure leaves `current` unchanged, while cache or post-switch failure leaves the new release selected; results identify the failed boundary and selected release without claiming that persistent environment or database effects were undone. Proof: Incus action `deployment-failure-boundaries`.
- [ ] Each application command emits stdout and stderr while running, observes its timeout, and terminates its owned process group on timeout or cancellation; further steps stop, and the operation deadline is the accepted step budget plus at most 900 seconds for infrastructure work. Proof: Incus action `deployment-output-timeout`.
- [ ] Concurrent deploy, rollback, layout adoption, removal, environment mutation/sync, and Route hostname changes cannot mutate the same production instance during this operation; a busy refusal occurs before those competing mutations, and interrupted commands are never resumed or automatically replayed. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Domain/DeploymentOperationExclusionTest.php` and Incus action `deployment-contention`.
- [ ] Explicit rollback selects a supplied retained release name beneath this instance’s `releases/`, verifies its owned source and web-root containment, switches atomically, and refreshes PHP cache; it neither fetches Git nor syncs environment nor runs deployment steps or changes database files. Proof: Incus action `deployment-code-rollback`.
- [ ] First deployment from a prepared release-layout fixture uses the same action with no old `current`; show can report the selected retained release directly from placement, and no deployment-run table, historical output store, or historical step snapshot is created. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Domain/DeployAppInstanceTest.php`.
- [ ] Maintained documentation describes deployment order, output limits, interruption, persistent side effects, and explicit code rollback, and generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] Changed project checks and repository suites pass. Proof: `cd apps/gateway && composer check`, and all five full no-TIA CI suites on the submitted candidate, plus focused affected Pest tests locally.
- [ ] Continuous requests against a compatible PHP fixture during activation receive complete old or new release responses, with no missing-root or unavailable-service response caused by the pointer switch or PHP refresh; agent commands that alter application availability retain their own effects. Proof: Incus action `deployment-serving-continuity`.
title: Deploy branch releases and roll back retained code
